instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/four_parts.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Create four FreeCAD Path/CAM Jobs or equivalent work-coordinate offsets for four identical parts. The offsets must correspond to G54, G55, G56, and G57 or another evaluable coordinate scheme. Apply the same Face and Profile operations to each part. Tool definition: T1 is reused across G54, G55, G56, and G57 or equivalent offsets. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-09.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
